fixes.explanation: Yes, baker! "After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac…" (Genesis 25:11). Abraham had been blessed by the LORD too (Genesis 24:1), and now Isaac gets his own. I think that's a good way to find out the story isn't ending when the funeral does. The verse says Isaac lived near Beer-lahai-roi. And God's blessing was already sitting there waiting for him, like a fresh batch cooling on the rack.

problems.problem: The joke about saying Beer-lahai-roi three times fast makes the pronunciation of a biblical place name the joke.
